+def load_image(image_path: str) -> bytes | None:
+    """Load inline images or objects from our configured storage, never a URL."""
+    if not image_path:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if image_path.startswith("data:image"):
+            header, encoded = image_path.split(",", 1)
+            if not header.lower().endswith(";base64"):
+                return None
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
+
+        parsed = urlsplit(image_path)
+        if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc:
+            host = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST or "")
+            prefix = host.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+            if (parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or
+                    parsed.scheme != host.scheme or parsed.netloc != host.netloc or
+                    not parsed.path.startswith(prefix) or parsed.query or parsed.fragment):
+                return None
+            key = unquote(parsed.path[len(prefix):])
+        else:
+            if image_path.startswith(("/", "\\")) or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+                return None
+            key = unquote(parsed.path)
+        if not key or "\\" in key or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

+import base64

+

+
+

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('url', [
+    'http://127.0.0.1/secret', 'https://example.com/image.png',
+    '//127.0.0.1/secret', 'http://minio.invalid:9000.evil/toonify-prod-assets/x',
+    'http://minio.invalid:9000/toonify-prod-assets/../secret',
+    'http://minio.invalid:9000/toonify-prod-assets/%2e%2e/secret',

+def test_image_consumers_reject_untrusted_urls(monkeypatch, url):
+    import requests
+    from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+    from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+    from app.services.storage import load_image, storage
+
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        pytest.fail('untrusted image triggered a request')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, 'get', forbidden)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, 'download_image', forbidden)
+    assert load_image(url) is None
+    assert BaseAIService._download_image(None, url) is None
+    assert download_image(url) is None
+
+
+def test_image_consumers_load_storage_and_data(monkeypatch):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+    from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+    from app.services.storage import load_image, storage
+
+    image = png_bytes()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, 'download_image', lambda key: image if key == 'images/test.png' else None)
+    for path in ('images/test.png', f'{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/images/test.png',
+                 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(image).decode()):
+        assert load_image(path) == image
+        assert BaseAIService._download_image(None, path) == image
+        assert download_image(path).size == (2, 2)
+
+
+def test_export_rejects_url_and_keeps_storage_and_data(client, monkeypatch):
+    import requests
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import Episode, StoryCut
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post('/api/v1/projects', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Test', 'genres': []}).json()
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        episode = Episode(project_id=project['id'], title='Test', episode_order=1)
+        session.add(episode)
+        session.commit()
+        session.refresh(episode)
+        cut = StoryCut(episode_id=episode.id, cut_order=1, script='', selected_layout='single', aspect_ratio='1:1')

+        session.commit()
